name: Berkeley Science Bowl
notes: Results page (Google Sites) requires sign-in; instead the public scoring backend (IMPORTRANGE source of stats.xlsx) gives all 90 RR + 30 DE games and links to one public scoring interface per game, whose question-by-question sheets give per-player correct/negs/TUH and team tossup/bonus points by subject (all scoresheet totals reproduce the scores). DE scoresheets carry no categories, so player stats are scope 'all' (overall, RR+DE) and 'rr' (overall + subjects); North Hollywood forfeited the bracket-reset final.
